# CANDIDATE: VIX_SPIKE_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday VIX spikes often coincide with short-term SPY pullbacks that reverse quickly, offering a long-side bounce. The edge exists because sudden fear-driven VIX spikes are frequently mean-reverting, creating oversold conditions in SPY that present high-probability long entries when confirmed by bullish engulfing candles above VWAP with elevated volume.

## Mechanism

Entry: If VIX increases >15% from its day-open value AND SPY forms a bullish engulfing candle (current bar closes above prior bar's open and below prior bar's close) at or above VWAP (close > VWAP) AND volume > 20-bar average volume, then enter long at the close of the engulfing candle.  
Exit: Initial stop at the low of the engulfing candle. Primary target at 1.5R (risk-reward). Secondary exit if VIX declines >10% from its intraday peak. Regime filters: Only active when daily open VIX < 30 and time between 10:00-14:30 ET; disabled during FOMC weeks or major economic releases (CPI, NFP, etc.).
